facts.fact: The BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the union in April 2026 to be connected to PI-SPI and serving customers by 30 June 2026.
On 25 June 2026 the BCEAO moved the connection deadline for banks, e-money issuers and payment institutions to 30 September 2026, and gave microfinance institutions until 30 June 2027.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
